dslRule:
<!id: string.trim.length.equals.zero.to.isblank>
<!description: Replace $string.trim().length() == 0 with $string.isBlank() when checking for blank strings (Java 11+).>
<!severity: HINT>
<!minJavaVersion: 11>

$newCharset.trim().length() == 0 :: sourceVersionGE(11) && instanceof($newCharset, "java.lang.String")
=> $newCharset.isBlank()
;;
